# Offer of Employment

**November 10, 2025**

Dear John,

Brightwater Analytics, Inc. is pleased to offer you employment on the following terms.

## Position
You will join Brightwater Analytics, Inc. as a full-time, exempt **Software Engineer II (L4)**, working remotely from San Diego, California, and reporting to Mary Major, Engineering Manager.

## Compensation
Your annual base salary will be **[$________ per year]**, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings.

## Equity
You will receive **3,200 restricted stock units (RSUs)**, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff, subject to the Company’s equity plan and applicable award agreement.

## Signing Bonus
You will receive a one-time signing bonus of **$20,000**, payable in your first regular paycheck and subject to applicable withholdings. If you voluntarily resign before completing 12 months of employment, you must repay the unearned portion, calculated as $20,000 × (12 minus the number of full months worked) ÷ 12. No amount will be deducted from your final wages without your separate written authorization.

## Start Date
Your anticipated start date is **[________]**.

## Benefits
You will be eligible for Company benefits subject to plan terms; please refer to the Benefits Guide provided with this letter.

## Contingencies
This offer is contingent on satisfactory completion of a background check and your providing documentation establishing your identity and authorization to work in the United States as required by law.

## At-Will Employment
Your employment is at will. You or the Company may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice.

## Governing Law
California law governs this letter and employment-related disputes. Any claim arising in California shall be brought in a court of competent jurisdiction located in California.

## Acceptance
Please indicate your acceptance by signing below.

**John Stiles:** ______________________________  **Date:** ______________

**Brightwater Analytics, Inc.:** ______________________________  **Date:** ______________

# Cover Note to Mary Major

Mary—The letter uses the approved requisition and leaves salary and start date open for your decision. Please resolve these items before it goes to John; his Nov. 7 verbal acceptance was based on terms that differ materially from the approved package, so the corrected terms should be discussed with him before sending.

- **Title:** Recruiter promised Senior Software Engineer; requisition approves Software Engineer II (L4). Recommend using the approved title. A relevel/title change needs VP Engineering and Finance approval through a revised requisition.
- **Base:** Promised $182,000; approved L4 range is $148,000–$175,000. Recommend $175,000, subject to your confirmation. An amount above the band needs VP Engineering and Finance approval.
- **Equity:** Promised 4,000 RSUs; approved grant is 3,200. Use 3,200; 4,000 requires Compensation Committee approval.
- **Signing bonus:** $20,000 is within the approved “up to $20,000.” The template’s full clawback is not appropriate for a California hire; the letter uses the company’s prorated approach and bars final-wage deductions absent separate written authorization. HR/Legal should confirm the wording.
- **Start date:** Dec. 1 was promised but is not in the requisition. Please confirm whether it is approved.
- **Non-compete / governing law:** Omit the non-compete, as requested and consistent with California law. Replace the Texas law/venue clause with California terms. Legal should confirm the state-specific language.

# Signing-Bonus Example

If John voluntarily resigns after **7 full months**, he would owe the unearned 5/12 of the bonus: **$20,000 × 5 ÷ 12 = $8,333.33**.
